requirements.text: Instant notifications for every transaction, including details like amount spent, merchant, and updated balance.
A simple option to freeze and unfreeze your card within the app with just a couple of taps.
Budgeting tools that allow users to set monthly budgets for different spending categories, with alerts for approaching or exceeding limits.
A dashboard that displays all accounts in one place (current account, savings, credit card balances) for a comprehensive overview.
The ability to send money quickly to friends or other accounts with ease.
Overall focus on ease of use and a modern, user-friendly interface.
